author: Athul Prem

finer_center_comparison.scope: The finer patch refines the center from the 168.75 nm baseline while preserving its outer cells. The comparison has no finer complementary response. The two central increments describe finite changes with their respective outer meshes fixed. They retain the original end phases and do not establish convergence.

scope: The taper patch retains coarse exterior cells and refines compatible central cells. The complementary control refines the rest of the coarse-to-fine changes. The mixed difference is the change in one region's finite refinement increment when the other is refined. Nonzero mixed differences make a single additive assignment of the observed response change to the two regions path-dependent. Each result is a finite mesh response at one frequency. Spatial and frequency convergence remain unresolved. Complex coefficients retain the original end-plane phases. Transmission and reflection eigenvalues are ranked by strength within each saved block. The equal incoherent mean uses five equal-power inputs.
